headline: Savage Clashes Sweep Linn of Mercy as Palantine Berm Churns
war_summary: Since our morning dispatch, the uneasy tactical deadlock in Linn of Mercy has broken, erupting into five base turnovers in the past two hours while absorbing an immense bloodletting of over 3,300 casualties, led by heavy fighting around Outwich Ranch and Lathair. Palantine Berm continues to endure torrential swings in control, recording thirteen strategic base exchanges in two hours centered on Vendett and Windburn Landing, accompanied by mounting casualty rates. In Weathered Expanse, where the line remains split with two positions unoccupied, combat has intensified sharply; seven base flips and nearly 1,900 casualties fell in the latest two-hour window across Spirit Watch, Crow's Nest, and Huntsfort. Conversely, the tempest in Marban Hollow has subsided into relative quiet after morning turmoil at Checkpoint Bua, with zero base shifts and sharply diminishing casualties over the last two hours. Nevish Line maintains an accelerating exchange of fire, racking up over 1,100 casualties and a fresh flip near Grief Mother, whereas Gutter and the broader southern sectors have lapsed into comparative calm following earlier skirmishes.
